modules.description: Active or passive recovery period.
modules.instructions: Take your time to rest and breathe deeply.
modules.safety_info: Do not sit down abruptly; keep slight movement.

modules.description: Plank, push-up and jump sequence.
modules.instructions: From standing, drop to plank, perform push-up, jump feet to hands and explode upward.
modules.safety_info: Keep core tight to avoid lumbar hyperextension during the jump.

modules.description: Abdominal flexion exercise.
modules.instructions: Lie on back, knees bent, and lift torso towards knees.
modules.safety_info: Keep core tight; do not pull on neck.

modules.description: Alternating forward steps.
modules.instructions: Step forward and lower hips until both knees are bent at a 90-degree angle.
modules.safety_info: Keep front knee aligned with ankle; do not let it pass toes.

modules.description: Explosive full body cardio jump.
modules.instructions: Jump while spreading legs and raising arms above head.
modules.safety_info: Land softly on the balls of your feet.

modules.description: Burpee without the push-up or jump.
modules.instructions: Drop to plank and jump feet back to hands rapidly.
modules.safety_info: Maintain a flat back in the plank position.

modules.description: Dynamic core stability and cardio.
modules.instructions: In plank, drive knees toward chest in an alternating running motion.
modules.safety_info: Keep hips level; do not bounce up and down.

modules.description: Lateral explosive jumps.
modules.instructions: Jump sideways, landing on one foot and swinging the other behind.
modules.safety_info: Focus on balance and controlled landings.

modules.description: Running in place with exaggerated knee lift.
modules.instructions: Bring knees as high as possible while running in place.
modules.safety_info: Stay on the balls of your feet; pump arms for momentum.

modules.description: Triceps-dominant close grip push-up.
modules.instructions: Form a diamond with hands under chest and lower body.
modules.safety_info: Keep elbows close to the ribs.

modules.description: Unilateral squat loading one leg.
modules.instructions: Descend laterally while keeping one leg completely straight.
modules.safety_info: Weight on the heel of the bending leg.

modules.description: Explosive core V-fold.
modules.instructions: Simultaneously lift torso and legs to touch toes in mid-air.
modules.safety_info: Avoid pulling on the neck; use abdominal strength.

modules.description: Shoulder-dominant push-up.
modules.instructions: In a V-position (hips up), lower head toward hands.
modules.safety_info: Look toward your feet to maintain neck alignment.

modules.description: Leg strength on elevated surface.
modules.instructions: Step onto a chair or box and stand up fully.
modules.safety_info: Ensure the surface is stable and secure.

modules.description: Posterior chain activation.
modules.instructions: Lying on back, lift hips toward ceiling and squeeze glutes.
modules.safety_info: Do not overarch the lower back at the top.

modules.description: Side-to-side athletic movement.
modules.instructions: Stay low in a partial squat and shuffle laterally.
modules.safety_info: Do not cross your feet; keep chest up.

modules.description: Rapid heels-to-glute movement.
modules.instructions: Jog in place, kicking heels up to touch the glutes.
modules.safety_info: Maintain a slight forward lean and soft landings.

modules.description: Jumping jack variation crossing arms and legs.
modules.instructions: Jump and cross arms/legs alternately in front.
modules.safety_info: Keep movements fluid and shoulders relaxed.

modules.description: Jumping jack with horizontal arm claps.
modules.instructions: Open and close arms horizontally while jumping.
modules.safety_info: Focus on opening the chest and retracting scapulae.

modules.description: Dynamic rhythmic punching.
modules.instructions: Perform jabs and crosses with light footwork.
modules.safety_info: Do not fully lock elbows on punches.

modules.description: Rapid low-impact foot turnover.
modules.instructions: Run in place with very short, quick steps.
modules.safety_info: Keep hips low and stay on the balls of the feet.

modules.description: Advanced core stabilization rocking.
modules.instructions: Maintain hollow hold and rock back and forth.
modules.safety_info: Lower back must stay pressed against the floor.

modules.description: Elevated rear foot unilateral squat.
modules.instructions: Place back foot on a bench and squat on the front leg.
modules.safety_info: Ensure front knee does not collapse inward.

modules.description: Dynamic plank with jumping legs.
modules.instructions: In plank position, jump feet out and in.
modules.safety_info: Keep hips level with shoulders; avoid sagging.

modules.description: Elevated feet push-up for upper chest.
modules.instructions: Feet on bench, perform push-ups focusing on shoulders.
modules.safety_info: Keep core tight to prevent lower back arching.

modules.description: Wide stance squat for inner thigh focus.
modules.instructions: Feet wide, toes out, squat deep with a pulse at bottom.
modules.safety_info: Keep knees tracking over the toes.

modules.description: Lower abdominal lift.
modules.instructions: Lying on back, lift straight legs to 90 degrees.
modules.safety_info: Press lower back into the floor throughout.

modules.description: Form-focused controlled push-ups.
modules.instructions: Perform standard push-ups with slow tempo (3s down).
modules.safety_info: Prioritize form; stop if technical breakdown occurs.

modules.description: Horizontal alternating leg kicks.
modules.instructions: Lying on back, kick legs over/under each other.
modules.safety_info: Keep legs as straight as possible; core engaged.

modules.description: Neural flow stability exercise.
modules.instructions: Alternately lower opposite arm and leg while on back.
modules.safety_info: Slow and controlled movement is key for neural sync.

modules.description: Backward lunge variation, easier on the knees.
modules.instructions: Step backward and lower hips until both knees are at 90 degrees.
modules.safety_info: Keep torso upright; do not let the front knee pass the toes.

modules.description: Rotational crunch targeting obliques.
modules.instructions: Simulate a pedalling motion while touching the opposite elbow to knee.
modules.safety_info: Do not pull on the neck; drive the movement from the abdomen.

modules.description: Standard bodyweight squat.
modules.instructions: Lower hips while keeping back straight, then stand up.
modules.safety_info: Heels must remain in contact with the floor throughout.

modules.description: Alternating lunges for muscular endurance.
modules.instructions: Perform lunges alternating legs on each repetition.
modules.safety_info: Keep knee aligned with the heel.

modules.description: Standard push-up with full range of motion.
modules.instructions: Lower chest to the floor keeping the body in a straight line.
modules.safety_info: Keep core activated to avoid lumbar hyperextension.

modules.description: Static core stabilization exercise focusing on anti-extension and spinal alignment.
modules.instructions: Maintain a straight line from head to heels, supported by forearms and toes. Engage glutes and core throughout the hold.
modules.safety_info: Avoid lumbar hyperextension; do not let the hips sag. Maintain a neutral neck position looking at the floor.

modules.description: (Easy Seated Breath) Calm seated breathing pose used to open and close a practice.
modules.instructions: Sit cross-legged with a tall spine, hands resting on the knees, and breathe slowly and evenly.
modules.safety_info: Sit on a folded blanket or cushion if the hips are tight.

modules.description: (Child's Pose) Restorative kneeling fold for the hips and lower back.
modules.instructions: Kneel and sit back onto the heels, folding the torso forward with arms extended.
modules.safety_info: Widen the knees if there is any pressure on the belly or knees.

modules.description: (Cat-Cow) Slow spinal flexion-extension flow synced with breath.
modules.instructions: On hands and knees, alternate arching and rounding the spine in rhythm with inhale/exhale.
modules.safety_info: Move slowly; do not force the range of motion in the neck.

modules.description: (Cobra) Gentle spinal extension for the lower back and chest.
modules.instructions: Lying face down, press through the hands to lift the chest while keeping hips on the floor.
modules.safety_info: Keep elbows slightly bent; do not force the lift if it strains the lower back.

modules.description: (Downward Dog) Inverted V-shape stretch and shoulder opener.
modules.instructions: From plank, lift hips up and back, pressing heels toward the floor and chest toward the thighs.
modules.safety_info: Keep a slight bend in the knees if hamstrings are tight; do not lock the elbows.

modules.description: (Standing Forward Fold) Standing hamstring and spine release.
modules.instructions: Hinge forward from the hips letting the head and arms hang toward the floor.
modules.safety_info: Bend the knees generously if the hamstrings or lower back feel tight.

modules.description: (Warrior II) Standing lunge hold building leg endurance and hip opening.
modules.instructions: Bend the front knee to 90 degrees, extend arms parallel to the floor, gaze over the front hand.
modules.safety_info: Keep the front knee tracking over the ankle; do not let it collapse inward.

modules.description: (Tree Pose) Single-leg standing balance pose.
modules.instructions: Root through one foot and place the opposite sole on the inner calf or thigh, hands at heart center.
modules.safety_info: Avoid resting the foot directly on the knee joint; use a wall for support if needed.

modules.description: (Bridge Pose) Held hip-opening backbend lying on the back.
modules.instructions: Lying on the back with knees bent, press through the feet to lift the hips and hold.
modules.safety_info: Keep the knees tracking straight; avoid letting them splay outward.

modules.description: (Seated Forward Fold) Seated hamstring and lower-back stretch.
modules.instructions: Sit with legs extended and hinge forward from the hips, reaching toward the feet.
modules.safety_info: Keep a soft bend in the knees if the lower back rounds excessively.

modules.description: (Sun Salutation) Continuous full-body sequence linking breath and movement.
modules.instructions: Flow through forward fold, plank, upward and downward dog in one continuous cycle.
modules.safety_info: Keep the movement slow and controlled; avoid holding the breath.

modules.description: (Commencing Form) Opening stance that settles weight and breath before the form.
modules.instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, slowly raise and lower the arms in time with the breath.
modules.safety_info: Keep the knees soft and weight centered throughout.

modules.description: (Cloud Hands) Slow flowing lateral arm-pulling movement.
modules.instructions: Shift weight side to side while the arms trace slow, circular pulling arcs in front of the body.
modules.safety_info: Keep the movement unhurried and continuous; soften the knees throughout.

modules.description: (Parting the Wild Horse's Mane) Diagonal weight-shifting step coordinating arms and legs.
modules.instructions: Step diagonally forward while one arm sweeps up and out and the other draws down and back.
modules.safety_info: Keep steps controlled and the front knee tracking over the ankle.

modules.description: (Brush Knee and Twist Step) Stepping form that brushes past the knee while rotating the torso.
modules.instructions: Step forward while one hand brushes past the knee and the other pushes forward at chest height.
modules.safety_info: Keep the stepping knee soft and avoid overreaching with the step.

modules.description: (Play the Guitar) Held weight-shift with the arms drawn in as if holding an instrument.
modules.instructions: Shift weight onto the back leg, bring the hands together in front of the chest, and hold.
modules.safety_info: Keep the shoulders relaxed and away from the ears.

modules.description: (Golden Rooster Stands on One Leg) Single-leg standing balance with a slow knee raise.
modules.instructions: Shift weight fully onto one leg and slowly raise the opposite knee, holding with control.
modules.safety_info: Keep a soft standing knee; use a wall for support if balance is limited.

modules.description: (Repulse the Monkey) Slow stepping-back flow coordinating the whole body.
modules.instructions: Step backward while one hand draws back and the other pushes forward, alternating sides continuously.
modules.safety_info: Keep steps small and controlled; do not rush the weight transfer.

modules.description: (White Crane Spreads Its Wings) Slow torso rotation and arm-lift flow for core stability.
modules.instructions: Shift weight onto the back leg while lifting one arm overhead and the other low, rotating gently at the core.
modules.safety_info: Move slowly and keep the core braced throughout the rotation.

modules.description: (Cross Hands, Closing Form) Closing form that gathers and settles energy at the end of the sequence.
modules.instructions: Cross the wrists in front of the chest, then slowly open the arms and lower them to the sides.
modules.safety_info: Keep the movement slow and the breath relaxed.
